rows.explainer:
We previously estimated this proportion at 27%, based on GW analysis (see link below), where we inferred the role of the physical barrier by comparing the effect sizes in trials of ITNs vs. untreated nets with trials of ITNs vs. no nets at all. We updated this estimate to 30% because the evidence supporting our original analysis is very uncertain, and we think the method we used is more likely to underestimate the role of the physical barrier than overestimate it.

rows.explainer: GiveWell reports this model's result in multiples of cash transfers. Multiplying by GiveWell's value of a dollar to GiveDirectly converts it into units of value per dollar, so it ranks against the other models. Older sheets used older moral weights; the multiple of cash is the comparable number across years.

rows.label: Units of value per dollar
